name: Boku-tachi no Asobikata 2
original_name: ぼくたちのあそびかた2
source:
2nd item in Bokuaso series. The same boys Shun and Itsuki go to the sea on a mid summer day!
What will be happening this time?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018303.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《我们的玩法》系列第二作。同样的男孩瞬和树在盛夏前往海边！
这次会发生什么？

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018303.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
